title: Between Runs
status: prose treatment complete; graphic script pending
summary: Dependency phase. Tide windows replace ordinary obligations, inland relationships drift, Nicole builds map logic, Justin escalates, Chris mythologizes, Matt becomes territorial, commercialization contaminates the Reach, the group cracks, and Ryan pulls away.
direction: Develop into full graphic script next. Keep everyone sympathetic. Commercialization should feel plausible, not cartoonish. End with Ryan alone at floodwall.

title: Return Tide
summary: The Big Run. Extreme low tide draws crowds. Kevin sees conditions are wrong. Justin pushes farther offshore, Matt allows momentum, Chris records, Nicole is distracted by discovery, the return route floods faster than expected, and Ryan disappears after turning back for stranded runners.
direction: This is the all-is-lost chapter. Disaster comes from stacked small failures, not one villain. No spectacle-first staging; fear should be cold, confused, and human.

title: After the Water
summary: Ryan returns alive, exhausted, and quietly furious. The story spreads as content. The group cannot return to normal. Matt tries to restore authority, Justin loses the audience, Chris deletes the archive, Nicole keeps mapping as witness, and Kevin states the real horror: the Reach did not make them alive; it made them impossible to ignore.
direction: Ryan's return is not relief; it forces everyone to live with what happened. Make aftermath longer and more emotionally metabolized than a plot resolution.

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: A smaller, sobered group crosses during a final extreme low tide. Ryan leads quietly and Matt accepts it. The Deep Reach is ordinary civic life — schools, parks, homes, plazas — never inhabited. The realization: nothing happened there; humanity simply stopped arriving. They retreat inland awake but not healed.
direction: Ending is acceptance, not triumph. The final crossing mirrors Chapter 1 with less wonder and more clarity. The ocean returns whether or not anyone is ready.
